title: Nkore language
description: Bantu language spoken by the Nkore and Hema peoples of Southwestern Uganda
extract: Nkore is a Bantu language spoken by the Nkore ("Banyankore") of south-western Uganda in the former province of Ankole, as well as in Tanzania, the DR Congo, Rwanda and Burundi.
